FarooqDrive help

  1. Create your own Google Cloud project and enable Google Drive API.
  2. Create a Web OAuth Client and add this site to Authorized JavaScript origins.
  3. Save the Client ID in Settings, then add your Google accounts.
  4. Use Back, Forward, Up, Home, or the clickable folder path to navigate.
  5. Select files to open, download, copy, cut, rename, or move to Trash. Undo restores the latest supported action.

No Client Secret belongs in this web app. Access tokens stay only in this page session.
